integrity: Exact all-parameter homotopy is established by orbit-barycenter and cross-polytope gluing arguments. Finite mod-two calculations only corroborate the statement; no automated infinite proof is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to geometric fixed loci of weight-three translations at inclusive Hamming scale three; it does not classify other translations, nontranslations, or residual equivariance. The 2026 representation-theory source was accessible only through its introduction and main theorem, not its full body. Independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
title: Weight-three translation fixed spaces in scale-three hypercube Rips complexes
